summary.text: Will Barfoot, a Republican, has been a member of the Alabama State Senate since November 2018; Ballotpedia lists his district as District 25, and his current term ends on November 4, 2026.

paragraphs.text: He earned a bachelor's degree in international studies from Auburn University and a J.D. from Jones School of Law.
He has worked as an attorney and was a co-founder of Barfoot & Schoettker.
